_comment: The course plates no longer live in the repository: they are requested from
Wikimedia Commons, where they came from, and the GCS bucket is the backup copy.
Each entry holds the EXACT Commons filename and the dimensions of the original.
The dimensions are not used to draw -- the CSS stretches the image to the width of
its frame -- but to reserve the aspect ratio before the image arrives.
This file is JSON rather than JS because two worlds read it: the Vite bundle and
scripts/mirror_assets.py, which downloads the copies uploaded to the bucket.
